title: PostReady: PR #453 — Landing 'say it once' + marquee/hero/create-screen polish (launch prep)
description: Launch-prep landing polish: messaging tightened to 'say it once' principle across headline, hero copy, marquee, and create-screen. Removes redundant explanatory text and tightens the value prop for first-time visitors. Merged Jul 8.

title: PostReady: PR #451 — Landing 'how it works' mobile clarity (numbered + stacked flow)
description: Mobile UX fix on postready-beta landing page: 'how it works' section rewritten with numbered steps and stacked layout for small screens — clarifies the 3-step flow that was hard to parse on mobile. Merged Jul 8.

title: PostReady: PR #443 — Multi-scene stitch step bounded (no retry-loop stall)
description: Fixed destructive retry-loop stall in the multi-scene stitch step (stitchClips → fal-ai/ffmpeg-api/merge-videos). STITCH_STEP_CONFIG had retries+timeouts misconfigured — same class as the scene-render bug fixed in PR #441. Bounds stitch to prevent hang after parallel render completes. Merged Jul 8.

title: PostReady: PR #442 — Multi-scene storyboard generator + hardened single-shot guard
description: 'Write my scenes for me' storyboard generator added: users describe their video idea, AI generates a full scene breakdown. Hardened single-shot guard prevents accidental multi-scene renders for basic prompts. Merged Jul 8.

title: PostReady: PR #441 — Parallel multi-scene render (fan-out/fan-in + timeouts + deliver-survivors)
description: Upgrades multi-scene render to parallel fan-out/fan-in: all scenes render concurrently instead of serially. Adds real per-scene timeouts and deliver-survivors logic — if one scene fails, completed scenes are still delivered. Merged Jul 7.

title: PostReady: PR #440 — Landing hero mobile fix (squished rocket + oversized headline)
description: Mobile-only fix for ZippityHero on postready-beta landing page: corrected squished rocket image aspect ratio and oversized headline text. Scoped to base/mobile Tailwind breakpoint, sm:/lg: untouched. Merged Jul 7.

title: PostReady: PR #439 — Multi-scene stability (no more silent hangs + per-scene progress)
description: Follow-up to multi-scene phase 1. Bounds every step in the render pipeline to prevent silent hangs; adds per-scene progress reporting during render. Merged Jul 7.

title: PostReady: PR #438 — Adaptive time copy for multi-scene Create Video
description: Fixed Create Video intro banner that quoted a hard '5–8 min' estimate — wrong for multi-scene renders (which stitch multiple scenes). Copy now adapts to scene count. Merged Jul 7.

title: PostReady: Multi-scene video + pre-launch cleanup (PRs #428–437)
description: 10 PRs merged Jul 7 afternoon: Multi-scene video phase 1 — scene builder → per-scene render → stitch → VO + captions, reference photo for character consistency across scenes, save-folder memory. Blog + Campaigns hidden behind feature flags pre-launch (reversible). Build fixes: lazy-load sharp, stale worker binary.

title: PostReady: Prompt Studio + major UX wave (PRs #418–427)
description: 10 PRs merged Jul 7: Prompt Studio in Create Post + Create Video, voiceover clip-duration sync, reference-image picker, Start Over button, batch prompt rows, unique download filenames, Seedream image size cap. Product live in beta at postready-beta.vercel.app. One paying client (Juvenis Medical).
